description:
What Orbb can and cannot answer. Called bare it returns a short overview and the list of questions it settles, with how much of each is public record and how much needs data only you hold.

The longer parts are named in that overview and fetched by name: the kinds of research and their limits, and what makes an introduction land.

Free.

about.description: Omitted, it returns the overview, which names the other parts (`overview` asks for it by name). `kinds` — the kinds of research, each population, limits and depths. `asking` — what makes an introduction land, and which half is yours. `questions` — what Orbb answers and what needs your data. `all` — every part at once, and long.
